logiciel de conception de circuits intégrés
Siemens EDA propose un portefeuille complet de logiciels de conception de circuits intégrés, allant de la conception basée sur C à la validation physique des circuits intégrés.

Relevez les défis de conception de circuits intégrés
Pour répondre à vos exigences en matière de performances, de puissance et de surface tout en proposant vos innovations en matière de circuits intégrés à temps, vous devez disposer d'un flux d'outils complet, de la conception au niveau C à la vérification d'approbation.
Synthèse et vérification de haut niveau
Solutions pour la conception basée sur C, la co-vérification matérielle/logicielle, la conception de circuits intégrés et la vérification physique et fonctionnelle.
Lieu et itinéraire
Plateforme de localisation et de routage pour la conception de circuits intégrés hiérarchiques de haut niveau et la mise en œuvre physique au niveau des blocs pour des circuits intégrés numériques complexes.
Analyse et optimisation de la puissance
Plateforme complète de développement basse consommation RTL qui identifie les sources de gaspillage d'énergie pour respecter les budgets énergétiques.
Conçu pour les tests
Solutions complètes de test et d'analyse du rendement du silicium pour la fabrication, le test, le débogage et la rampe de rendement pour les SoC modernes.
Design FPGA
Solutions de conception FPGA intégrées allant de la conception C/RTL à la synthèse FPGA, en passant par la vérification fonctionnelle, la vérification de l'équivalence logique et la conception de circuits imprimés.
Design et synthèse RTL
Les designers ont besoin d'une solution qui optimise à un niveau d'abstraction plus élevé et laisse beaucoup plus de place à l'amélioration de la QoR.
Vérification physique et optimisation des circuits intégrés
Les outils de vérification et d'optimisation physiques EDA de Siemens EDA fournissent des résultats fiables qui permettent aux entreprises de conception de proposer des produits compétitifs et de pointe en temps opportun sur des marchés en évolution rapide.
Analyse de l'intégrité de l'alimentation
Les outils d'analyse de l'intégrité de l'alimentation mPower permettent une analyse de l'intégrité de l'alimentation précise, évolutive et facile à utiliser, pour les conceptions analogiques et numériques, du plus petit bloc au plus grand schéma complet de puces.

entrée de conception pour une validation physique de renommée mondiale.

Synthèse de haut niveau C++/SystemC de pointe avec estimation/optimisation à faible consommation d'énergie. La vérification du design, du code et de la couverture fonctionnelle ainsi que la vérification formelle font du HLS bien plus qu'un simple « C à RTL ».

title: Whistleblowing and Reporting Channels | Siemens
text:
Whistleblowing and Reporting Channels | Siemens

Skip to main content

Home
Whistleblowing and Reporting
Whistleblowing and reporting channels
Here are some ways you can help us.

Tell Us if you believe something is not right
Report
Suspected or actual violations of law or company policy,
at Siemens or in our Supply Chain,
whether you are a Siemens employee or not.
We will
Provide feedback while protecting the confidentiality of all involved,
protect you from mistreatment or retaliation, and
treat your report confidentially to the maximum extent.
You help us
Do the right thing and
identify improper conduct.

Thank you for your trust and support.
Tell Us

FAQs
Does Siemens have corporate-wide rules of procedure?
Yes. Siemens operates a corporate-wide, transparent, publicly available, and standardized complaint and reporting procedure that is fully accessible. All complaints and reports from employees or third parties are treated similarly insofar as it is legally permitted.
Who can submit complaints and reports?
Everybody. The complaint and reporting procedure is open to all Siemens employees, external persons, and other organizations.
What can I report?
Any suspected or actual violations of laws or internal regulations, including those relating to human rights and environmental risks or obligations. The suspicion can be directed at individual Siemens employees, a Siemens business, or a Siemens supplier.
Do I have various options for submitting complaints or reports?
Yes. Siemens has various reporting channels for complaints or reports.
Complaints and reports can be submitted via the “
Tell Us
” hotline 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. They can be in writing or by phone – and you don’t even have to give your name if you don’t want to.
“Tell Us” is available in many different languages and is managed by an independent operator. The data is stored on protected servers in Germany. The content of the complaints or reports is processed exclusively by Siemens.
An external
Ombudsperson
is also available. The Ombudsperson is an independent lawyer outside Siemens whom you can contact confidentially and anonymously.
If you prefer to contact someone directly at Siemens, feel free to speak to any one of our Compliance Officers. You can also contact other Legal and Compliance personnel, company managers, the Human Resources personnel, employee representatives, or the Siemens Chief Compliance Officer.
Who will take care of my complaint or report?
The Siemens internal investigation department. This is the company’s central “Reporting Office”, which handles all complaints and reports, regardless of how they were submitted. The Reporting Office reports directly to the Chief Compliance Officer, who has access to the Managing Board and the Supervisory Board of Siemens AG. Employees of the Reporting Office are subject to a special duty of confidentiality, are impartial, and have the necessary expertise to professionally handle complaints and reports.
The company may contact you if additional information is needed, and in some instances the German Supply Chain Due Diligence Act (LkSG) may require us to discuss with you your complaint. Of course, this only works if we can contact you.
Will the company keep my identity confidential?
Yes. All complaints and reports may be submitted anonymously, and Siemens takes great care to protect you as a reporter and ensures your complaint or report is kept confidential. Confidential data may only be disclosed on an as-needed basis as permitted by law. These principles apply regardless of the reporting channel.
Will I be informed that my complaint or report is being processed?
Yes. Within seven days of receipt of your complaint or report, you will receive an acknowledgement of receipt from Siemens.
Will all complaints and reports be processed?
Yes. We take all complaints and reports seriously. The Reporting Office examines each complaint and report to clarify whether there is sufficient information to process the matter. We may request additional information from you.
What happens to my complaint or report once it has been examined?
It depends: After the Reporting Office examines your complaint or report, it may forward it to another responsible department within the company for further handling and fact-finding or to a competent authority, or handle it itself. If the Reporting Office deems an internal investigation necessary, an Investigation Mandate will be issued. During the investigation, the Reporting Office reviews relevant documents, speaks with witnesses and affected parties, and, if necessary, analyzes electronic data.
At the end of the fact-finding, the results are summarized in a report that is distributed to relevant internal stakeholders. Results may include recommendations for disciplinary action or other remedial measures, such as risk management and internal process measures.
Insofar as it is possible and legally permissible, we will inform you
within three months
of the measures taken – even if the fact-finding has not been completed by then.
Are there rules in place for fact-finding?
Yes. All employees who are involved in internal fact-finding must adhere to certain
rules of conduct
, including:
The whistleblower must be protected! Their name and details of their report must be kept confidential on a need-to-know basis.
All fact-finding must be performed respectfully, objectively, and without any presumption.
Employees implicated by a complaint or report have the right to be heard.
Data and information must be treated confidentially on a need-to-know basis and consistent with legal requirements.
Any potential or actual conflict of interest on the part of any person engaged in fact-finding must be disclosed and the fact-finder must remove themselves from the matter.
Am I protected as a whistleblower?
Yes. Siemens will not tolerate retaliation of any kind.
Persons who in good faith submit complaints or reports will be fully protected. If you believe you or anyone else has been retaliated against or in any way has been treated differently for submitting a complaint or report, you should inform our company immediately through any of its reporting channels (preferably via “
Tell Us
“).
We follow up on all plausible allegations of retaliation or mistreatment. Severe measures will be imposed in response to substantiated act of retaliation.

Siemens Cookie Notice
Last updated: February 2026
This Cookie Notice applies to the websites, applications, online services or marketplaces accessible under "siemens.com" (each, a "website") offered by Siemens AG or one of its affiliates ("Siemens").
This website uses cookies. Cookies are small files that contain certain information and are stored on your device. The cookies on this website come either from Siemens - in which case they are so-called "first party cookies" - or from certain third parties whose services Siemens uses; in this case, we speak of "third-party cookies".
Cookies are necessary to provide certain functionalities on a website, e.g., to maintain a language choice made by a user. Moreover, cookies enable the respective issuer (Siemens or a third party) to recognize that the website was previously called up by a certain end device, allowing the identification of returning visitors (or rather their end devices) and gathering information about their usage of the website and their presumed interests. This information is used to improve the website and to deliver relevant advertisement for Siemens products and services on the website as well as on third party sites.
Cookies can be assigned to four categories, depending on their function and intended purpose: absolutely necessary cookies, performance cookies, functionality cookies, and marketing cookies.
Strictly Necessary Cookies
These cookies are essential in order to enable you to move around the website and use its features, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. Without these cookies, services requested through usage of our website cannot be properly provided.
Strictly necessary cookies do not require consent from the user under applicable law. You may configure your web browser to block strictly necessary cookies, but you might then not be able to use the website’s functionalities as intended.
To the extent that information processed in connection with strictly necessary cookies should qualify as personal data in a given case, the legal ground for that processing is Siemens’ legitimate interest in operating the website.
Performance Cookies
These cookies collect information about how visitors use a website, for instance which pages visitors go to most often, and how visitors move around the site. They help us to better understand a user’s behavior on our webpage. This is necessary to improve the user friendliness of a website and therefore enhance the user’s experience. Further information collected by performance cookies may include e.g.: internet browser and operating system used, the domain name of the website which you previously visited, the number of visits, average duration of visit, and pages called up.
In general, the information collected by these cookies is aggregated and can normally not be linked to a specific natural person. However, in certain cases the collected information can be linked to you directly (provided you disclose your identity to Siemens, e.g., when creating an account or filing a request with us). To the extent that information processed in connection with performance cookies can, in a given case, be directly linked to you or otherwise qualifies as personal data, the legal ground for that processing is your user consent.
Functionality Cookies
These cookies allow the website to remember choices you make or information you enter (such as your username, language or the region you are in) and provide enhanced, more personal features. They are also used to enable requested functions such as playing videos. To the extent that information processed in connection with functionality cookies should, in a given case, qualify as personal data, the legal ground for that processing is the user’s consent.
Marketing Cookies
Marketing cookies (also referred to as targeting or advertising cookies) are used to deliver adverts on third party websites more relevant to you and your interests. They are also used to limit the number of times you see an advertisement as well as help measure the effectiveness of an advertising campaign.
Legal basis for the processing of personal data in connection with marketing cookies (if any) is the user’s consent.
Further Information
Siemens AG and, where applicable, the affiliated company named in the imprint of this website are jointly responsible for personal data processed on this website with the help of cookies. For this reason, they have set out their respective data protection obligations in an agreement; a summary of the content of that agreement is made available upon request. In case of any request in connection with this Cookie Notice, please contact the Data Privacy Organization at
dataprotection@siemens.com
.

title: Data Privacy | Siemens | Siemens
text:
Data Privacy | Siemens | Siemens

Home
Data privacy

Privacy@Siemens
Data privacy is an integral part of Siemens' business activities and processes. This website provides insight on the various elements that form the Siemens approach to data privacy that is committed to protecting the privacy of our employees, customers, suppliers and consumers.

Your data, your rights
We believe that one of the most important elements of a company’s data privacy program is to provide transparency on its processing operations. That is why we developed our
Data Privacy Notice
to explain how we handle personal data and how you can exercise your rights.
You control your data – Siemens as data processor
Using our products and services often means entrusting Siemens with processing one of the most valuable assets of a company – its data. That is why data privacy forms an integral part of our offerings. You can learn more by visiting the
Siemens Data Privacy Trust Center
.
Security
There is no Privacy without Security. With our unique holistic cybersecurity approach, we make it possible for you to introduce and maintain a digitized organization that is secure and reliable at all times. By combining this with our global leading technology and industrial expertise, we are continually working on reinforcing the comprehensive protections among all our products, solutions and services. That’s how we keep you – and society as a whole – secure. Please visit our
Cybersecurity website
to learn more.
Our global data privacy commitment – The Binding Corporate Rules
Protecting personal data is a top priority for all companies within the Siemens group. For this reason, Siemens was one of the first companies within Germany to obtain and implement Binding Corporate Rules (BCR) approved by the data protection authorities of the European Union. Siemens has also obtained and implemented the BCR for the United Kingdom (UK BCR Addendum) which were approved by the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO). Siemens’ BCR certification demonstrates our strong commitment to the protection of personal data whenever it is transferred or accessed globally by Siemens’ companies. You find a summary of the Siemens EU BCR and the UK BCR Addendum below:
-
Siemens EU BCR
-
UK BCR Addendum
You are in the driver seat – Data privacy in Siemens products and services
We build in privacy from the start. When designing, planning and developing our products and services, we embed data privacy milestones directly into the product development process and strive to provide features and functionalities that give customers full control over their data privacy settings.
Our mission: Siemens Data Privacy Management System
Siemens values the importance of privacy and protecting personal information. To put data privacy into action throughout the Siemens group, we developed and implemented the Siemens Data Privacy Management System. Siemens closely monitors regulatory developments as well as reports, guidance, recommendations and statements of its competent data protection authorities and the European Data Protection Board. If required, we update our Data Privacy Management accordingly.
In this section, you will find a summary of our Data Privacy Management System and where you can get more information.

Digitalna nit
Digitalna nit: redefiniranje digitalne transformacije
U doba pametne proizvodnje, digitalna nit je pristup inovacijama, optimizaciji i operativnoj izvrsnosti koji mijenja igru. Siemens Digital Industries Software pruža digitalne niti prilagođene kako bi pomogli modernim poduzećima da složenost pretvore u konkurentsku prednost.
Pregledajte digitalne teme

Što je digitalna nit?
Digitalna nit objedinjuje svaku fazu životnog ciklusa proizvoda — od koncepta do proizvodnje. Stvara pouzdan protok podataka, razgrađuje silose, potiče suradnju i donosi brže odluke. Ova vidljivost od kraja do kraja pretvara procese u agilno poduzeće, ubrzavajući inovacije, poboljšavajući kvalitetu i poboljšavajući korisničko iskustvo.

Poticanje inovacija
Kakvu ulogu igra digitalna nit?
Digitalna nit transformativna je sila koja nadilazi puka tehnološka rješenja, služeći kao strateški pokretač organizacijama da prevladaju izazove i otključaju neviđenu poslovnu vrijednost. Digitalna nit:
Poboljšava suradnju poduzeća i osnažuje pravovremeno, informirano donošenje odluka. Razbijanjem komunikacijskih barijera i pružanjem sveobuhvatnog, cjelovitog prikaza životnog ciklusa proizvoda omogućuje timovima da rade u skladu s zajedničkim ciljevima, potičući učinkovitost i produktivnost.
Ubrzava uvođenje novih proizvoda i pomaže u upravljanju sve većom složenošću modernog razvoja proizvoda. Koristeći uvide u stvarnom vremenu i mogućnosti predviđanja, organizacije mogu brzo odgovoriti na evoluirajuće zahtjeve tržišta, optimizirati strategije održavanja i pružiti iznimno korisničko iskustvo.
Pruža ranu vidljivost promjena dizajna, eliminirajući skupe i rasipne posljedice izmjena u kasnoj fazi. Ovaj pristup usmjeren na budućnost omogućuje proaktivno rješavanje problema i učinkovitu ponovnu upotrebu podataka o proizvodu, dodatno komprimiranje vremenskih rokova i poboljšanje ukupne operativne izvrsnosti.

Koje su ključne prednosti pristupa digitalnim nitima?
Poboljšana suradnja
Razbijte silose i potaknite besprijekornu komunikaciju između odjela.
Poboljšana učinkovitost
Pojednostavite poslovanje i smanjite vrijeme stavljanja na tržište pomoću uvida zasnovanog na podacima.
Vrhunska kvaliteta proizvoda
Iskoristite petlje povratnih informacija u stvarnom vremenu kako biste poboljšali proizvode i rano riješili probleme.
Sustainability
Smanjite otpad i optimizirajte korištenje resursa kroz prediktivnu analitiku i automatizaciju.
Izuzetna iskustva kupaca
Isporučite pouzdane, visokokvalitetne proizvode podržane robusnom servisnom podrškom.

Digitalne niti za svaki proces
Digitalne niti pojednostavljuju lance opskrbe, poboljšavaju razvoj proizvoda i jačaju sigurnost. Oni nude skalabilne, prilagodljive mogućnosti koje pokreću učinkovitost i inovacije u svim industrijama.

Projektni inženjering
Ponovno zamislite dizajn proizvoda uz vrhunske alate i suradnju u stvarnom vremenu. Ova nit omogućuje inženjerima stvaranje pametnijih, inovativnijih proizvoda integrirajući uvide zasnovane na podacima u proces dizajna.

Smart Manufacturing koristi podatke u stvarnom vremenu, automatizaciju i analitiku za optimizaciju proizvodnje, povećavajući učinkovitost, fleksibilnost i preciznost od dizajna proizvoda do izvršenja proizvodnje.

all
Integrirano upravljanje životnim ciklusom
Objedinite podatke tijekom životnog ciklusa proizvoda uz besprijekornu integraciju dizajna, proizvodnje i operativnih uvida. Ova nit osnažuje timove da održavaju jedinstveni izvor istine, poboljšavajući suradnju i donošenje odluka.
all
Sistemsko inženjerstvo zasnovano na modelima (MBSE)
Podignite složeni dizajn sustava integriranjem mehaničkih, električnih i softverskih sustava u jedinstveni digitalni model. Ova nit pruža holistički pogled na inženjering sustava, osiguravajući pouzdanost i performanse.
all
Analitika životnog ciklusa usluge
Omogućite iznimno korisničko iskustvo korištenjem prediktivnog održavanja, analitike upotrebe i petlji povratnih informacija. Ova nit osigurava da proizvodi ostanu pouzdani i ispunjavaju očekivanja kupaca tijekom cijelog životnog ciklusa.
all
Suradnja u lancu opskrbe
Potaknite jača partnerstva i poboljšajte vidljivost u cijelom lancu opskrbe. Ova nit koristi digitalne blizance i podatke u stvarnom vremenu za poboljšanje suradnje, smanjenje kašnjenja i optimizaciju upravljanja zalihama.

Digitalne teme po industriji
Digitalne niti postavljaju temelje za transformaciju, ali njihov pravi utjecaj dolazi od prilagodbe specifične za industriju. Industrijske digitalne niti poboljšavaju osnovne mogućnosti, usklađujući digitalne strategije s izazovima specifičnim za sektor, tijekovima rada i mogućnostima za maksimalnu učinkovitost i inovacije.

Često postavljana pitanja o digitalnoj temi
Što je digitalna nit i zašto je važna?
Digitalna nit je kontinuirani protok podataka koji povezuje svaku fazu životnog ciklusa proizvoda, od dizajna do proizvodnje, usluge i šire. Važno je jer uklanja silose, poboljšava suradnju, poboljšava učinkovitost i ubrzava inovacije osiguravajući jedinstveni izvor istine u organizaciji.
Kako se digitalna nit razlikuje od digitalnog blizanca?
digital twin blizanac je virtualni prikaz fizičke imovine, sustava ili procesa, koji se koristi za simulaciju i analizu. S druge strane, digitalna nit je besprijekorna integracija podataka tijekom životnog ciklusa proizvoda, omogućujući kontinuitet i sljedivost u različitim fazama.
Koje industrije imaju najviše koristi od digitalnih niti?
Industrije poput proizvodnje, zrakoplovstva, automobilske industrije, zdravstva i energije značajno imaju koristi od digitalnih niti. Ove se industrije oslanjaju na složeni razvoj proizvoda, upravljanje lancem opskrbe i uvid u podatke u stvarnom vremenu kako bi potaknule učinkovitost i inovacije.
S kojim se izazovima tvrtke suočavaju prilikom implementacije digitalne niti?
Neki uobičajeni izazovi uključuju:
Integracija naslijeđenih sustava s modernom digitalnom infrastrukturom
Upravljanje ogromnim količinama podataka u odjelima
Osiguravanje sigurnosti i usklađenosti podataka
Dobivanje organizacijske prijave za inicijative digitalne transformacije
Kako tvrtke mogu početi implementirati digitalnu nit?
Tvrtke mogu započeti s:
Procjena trenutne digitalne zrelosti — Utvrđivanje praznina u povezanosti podataka i tijekovima rada
Definiranje jasnih poslovnih ciljeva - Postavljanje ciljeva kao što su povećanje učinkovitosti, smanjenje troškova ili poboljšana suradnja
Ulaganje u prave digitalne alate
—
Usvajanje

PLM, IoT, AI i tehnologije automatizacije
Osiguravanje interoperabilnosti podataka — stvaranje besprijekorne integracije u naslijeđenim i modernim sustavima
Poticanje kulture digitalnog

usvajanje — Obuka zaposlenika i poticanje načina razmišljanja usmjerenog na inovacije
Što je održivo digitalno poduzeće?
Održiv
Digitalno poduzeće
Siemensov jedinstveni pristup kombiniranja stvarnog i digitalnog svijeta sa svojim holističkim portfeljem, dugogodišnjim iskustvom i domenskim znanjem omogućuje industrijskim tvrtkama da besprijekorno integriraju i digitaliziraju cijeli životni ciklus proizvoda i proizvodnje, uključujući lanac opskrbe. To pomaže postati održivo digitalno poduzeće za kontinuiranu optimizaciju na temelju podataka i stvaranje najboljih proizvoda i proizvodnje u svojoj klasi za održiviju budućnost.
Koje su prednosti postajanja digitalnim poduzećem?
Sposobnost kombiniranja stvarnog i digitalnog svijeta omogućuje tvrtkama da dizajniraju, simuliraju, testiraju, optimiziraju i potvrđuju proizvode, strojeve, linije, pa čak i cijele tvornice i postrojenja u digitalnom svijetu, čineći ih bržim, učinkovitijim i održivijim u stvarnom svijetu. Rezultat je kontinuirana petlja optimizacije, od dizajna proizvoda do njegove realizacije i optimizacije, uz kontinuirani protok podataka. Održivo digitalno poduzeće može iskoristiti neograničenu snagu podataka stjecanjem vrijednih uvida za donošenje brzih i sigurnih odluka. To je moguće samo zato što u Siemensu činimo sve što možemo kako bismo našim kupcima pružili cjelovita rješenja koja su im potrebna kako bi postali bolji, brži, profitabilniji i održiviji: hardver za automatizaciju, industrijski softver i holistički pristup koji im omogućuje da cijeli životni ciklus proizvoda i proizvodnje, uključujući lance opskrbe, učine učinkovitijim i održivijim. Drugim riječima, postati održivo digitalno poduzeće sa Siemens Xceleratorom omogućuje jasne koristi ljudima i društvu pružanjem tehnologije za transformaciju svakodnevice, za svakoga.

Home
IC softver za dizajn

IC softver za dizajn
Siemens EDA nudi sveobuhvatan portfelj softvera za dizajn IC koji se proteže od unosa dizajna temeljenog na C do fizičke potpisivanja IC verifikacije.

Osvojite izazove IC dizajna
Ispunjavanje zahtjeva za performansama, snagom i područje uz istovremeno isporuku vaših IC inovacija na vrijeme zahtijeva sveobuhvatan protok alata koji se proteže od dizajna na razini C pa sve do provjere potpisa.
Sinteza i provjera na visokoj razini
Solutions za dizajn temeljen na C, zajedničku provjeru hardvera/softvera, IC dizajn i fizičku i funkcionalnu provjeru.
Mjesto i ruta
Platforma mjesta i rute za hijerarhijski dizajn IC-a na najvišoj razini i fizičku implementaciju na razini bloka za složene digitalne IC-ove.
Analiza i optimizacija snage
Kompletna RTL razvojna platforma male snage koja pronalazi izvore izgubljene energije za ispunjavanje proračuna energije.
Dizajn za ispitivanje
Sveobuhvatna rješenja za ispitivanje silicija i analizu prinosa za ispitivanje proizvodnje, uklanjanje pogrešaka i rampu prinosa za moderne SoC-ove.
FPGA dizajn
Integrirana FPGA dizajnerska rješenja od C/RTL dizajna, FPGA sinteze, funkcionalne provjere, provjere logičke ekvivalencije do dizajna PCB-a.
RTL dizajn i sinteza
Dizajneri trebaju rješenje koje se optimizira na višoj razini apstrakcije koja predstavlja daleko više prostora za poboljšanje QoR -a.
IC fizička provjera i optimizacija
Siemens EDA alati za fizičku provjeru i optimizaciju pružaju pouzdane rezultate koji dizajnerskim tvrtkama omogućuju pravovremenu isporuku najsuvremenijih, konkurentnih proizvoda na tržišta koja se brzo kreću.
Analiza integriteta snage
MPower alati za analizu integriteta snage omogućuju preciznu, skalabilnu i jednostavnu analizu integriteta snage za analogne i digitalne dizajne, od najmanjeg bloka do najvećih rasporeda punog čipa.
Portfelj IC dizajna
Siemens EDA ima sveobuhvatan portfelj softvera za dizajn IC koji se proteže od razine C
dizajn ulaz u znak fizičke provjere svjetske klase.

all

Simulacija kruga
all
Analogna platforma FastSpice
Najbrža platforma za provjeru nanometarskog kruga na svijetu za analogne, RF, mješovite signale i prilagođene digitalne sklopove.

all

Alati za fizičku provjeru
all

Calibre Design Solutions pruža cjelovitu platformu za provjeru IC i DFM optimizaciju koja ubrzava dizajn od stvaranja do proizvodnje, zadovoljavajući sve zahtjeve za potpisivanje.
HLS i provjera
all
Katapult
Vodeća u industriji C++/SystemC sinteza na visokoj razini s procjenju/optimizacijom male snage. Provjera dizajna, provjera koda i funkcionalne pokrivenosti plus formalna čine HLS više od pukog "C-to-RTL".
S-Edit i L-Edit
all
Prilagođeni IC
Paket alata nudi dovršeno dizajnersko okruženje za potpuno prilagođene IC dizajne uključujući tehnologije More than Moore - MEMS i fotoniku
Analiza integriteta snage
all

Paket alata mPower omogućuje dizajnerskim timovima da izvrše skalabilnu analognu i digitalnu analizu integriteta snage od najmanjih blokova do najvećih rasporeda punog čipa kako bi provjerili da dizajni ispunjavaju ciljeve dizajna povezane s napajanjem i performanse.

We (meaning the specific company that has provided or referred you to this privacy notice or that is identified on this page as being the operator of this website) believe that protecting the security and privacy of your personal data is important. This Privacy Notice explains how we collect, store, use, disclose and transfer (hereinafter “
process
”) your personal data. The personal data that we collect about you depends on the context of your interactions with us, the products, services and features that you use, your location, and applicable law.

How we handle your data
1. Processing of personal data related to your use of our websites, applications and services
Categories of personal data processed, and purpose of the processing
When visiting our external and internal websites or using our applications, or online services (each an “
Online Offering
”), we may process the following categories of personal data:
Your contact information, such as full name, address, telephone number, mobile phone number and email address;
Organizational information, including job position and company name;
Your date of birth in case of Offerings requiring verification of your age;
Information submitted as part of a support request, survey or comment or forum post;
Further personal data that you provide by filling in forms in our Offerings;
Information on your interaction with the Offering, including your device and user identifier, information on your operating system, sites and services accessed during your visit, the date and time of each visitor request; and
Personal data accessed through permissions you grant to our mobile applications, such as your device’s location data (e.g. GPS coordinates for asset tracking), camera input (e.g. barcode scans for inventory), microphone input (e.g. for voice commands), stored files or media (e.g. for uploading diagnostic reports), Bluetooth connectivity (e.g. for interacting with nearby industrial equipment), local network access (e.g., for connecting to on-premise systems), and notification settings (e.g. for receiving service-related alerts), insofar as you choose to use features that require such access. You may grant or deny such permissions at any time via your device settings.
We process your personal data for the following purposes:
To provide the Offering’s services and functions which includes creating and administering your online account, updating, securing, and troubleshooting, providing support, as well as improving and developing our Offerings;
To bill your use of the Offering;
To verify your identity;
To verify your age;
To answer and fulfill your requests or instructions;
To process your order or to provide you with access to specific information or offers;
To contact you with information and offers concerning our products and services, to send you further marketing information or to contact you in the context of customer satisfaction surveys as explained in Section 4; and
As reasonably necessary to enforce the Offering’s terms, to establish or preserve a legal claim or defense, to prevent fraud or other illegal activities, including attacks on our information technology systems.
Offerings provided by your organization
Our Offerings may be provided to you for your use by the organization to which you belong, such as our enterprise customers. If your organization provides you with access to an Offering, our processing of personal data provided by or collected from you or your organization in connection with the Offering’s content is performed under the direction of your organization and is subject to a data processing agreement between your organization and us. In such instance, your organization is responsible for any personal data contained in such content and you should direct any questions about how personal data contained in such content is used to your organization.
2. Processing of personal data related to your use of our marketplace
Categories of personal data processed, and purpose of the processing
When visiting our online marketplace (“
Marketplace
”), we may process the following categories of personal data:
Your contact information, such as full name, address, telephone number, mobile phone number and email address;
Organizational information, including job position and company name;
Payment data, such as data necessary for processing payments and fraud prevention, including credit/debit card numbers, security code numbers and other related billing information;
Information submitted as part of a support request, survey or comment or forum post;
Further personal data that you provide by filling in forms in our Marketplace;
Information that are legally required compliance screenings or export control checks; such as date of birth, nationality, place of residence, ID numbers, identity cards and information about relevant and significant litigation or other legal proceedings; and
Information on your interaction with the Marketplace, including your device and user identifier, information on your operating system, sites and services accessed during your visit, the date and time of each visitor request.
We process your personal data for the following purposes:

Data Controller
The company that provides you with this Privacy Notice, or that is identified as the operator of the relevant website, application, or service, is the controller responsible for processing your personal data under the UK GDPR. In the course of our business relationship with you, we may share Business Partner contact information with affiliated Siemens companies. We and these Siemens companies are jointly responsible for the proper protection of your personal data (Art. 26 UK GDPR). To allow you to effectively exercise your data subject rights in the context of this joint controllership, we entered into an agreement with these Siemens companies granting you the right to centrally exercise your data subject rights under section 7 of this Privacy Notice against Siemens Aktiengesellschaft, Germany. dataprotection@siemens.com
.

The UK GDPR requires us to provide you with information on the legal basis of the processing of your personal data.

exercising our rights and performing our obligations under any contract we make with you (Article 6 (1) (b) UK GDPR) (“
Contract Performance

Compliance with Legal Obligations

Legitimate interests pursued by us (Article 6 (1) (f) UK GDPR) (“
Legitimate Interest
”). Generally, the legitimate interest pursued by us in relation to our use of your personal data is the efficient performance or management of (i) your use of the Offerings, and/or (ii) our business relationship with you. Where the below table states that we rely on our legitimate interests for a given purpose, we are of the opinion that our legitimate interest is not overridden by your interests and rights or freedoms, given (i) the regular reviews and related documentation of the processing activities described herein, (ii) the protection of your personal data by our data privacy processes, (iii) the transparency we provide on the processing activity, and (iv) the rights you have in relation to the processing activity. If you wish to obtain further information on this balancing test approach, please contact our Data Privacy Organization at:
dataprotection@siemens.com
.

Do Not Track

Usage by Children

This Offering is not directed to children under the age of thirteen. We will not knowingly collect personal data from children under the age of thirteen without insisting that they seek prior parental consent if required by applicable law. We will only use or disclose personal data about a child to the extent permitted by law, to seek parental consent, pursuant to local law and regulations or to protect a child.

A. General Terms of Use

1. Scope
These Terms of Use, along with any specific terms when applicable, govern the interactions of any visitor on this Website and any functionally related websites (“

1.2. In the case of web offers aimed at companies or public enterprises, such companies or enterprises are represented by the User and must assume that the User has appropriate knowledge and acts accordingly.
2. Services
2.1. The Siemens Website contains specific information and software, as well as - as the case may be - related documentation, for viewing or downloading. The Siemens Website may also serve as or provide access to online platforms or marketplaces for the promotion and transaction of offerings from Siemens and/or third parties.
2.2. Siemens may stop the operation of the Siemens Website in full or in part at any time. Due to the nature of the internet and computer systems, Siemens cannot accept any liability for uninterrupted availability of the Siemens Website.
3. Registration, Password
3.1. Some pages of the Siemens Website may be password protected. In the interest of safety and security of business transactions, only registered Users may access said pages. Siemens reserves the right to deny registration to any User. Siemens particularly reserves the right to make certain sites, which were previously freely accessible, subject to registration. Siemens is entitled, at any time and without obligation to give reasons, to deny the User the right to access the password-protected area by blocking its User Data (as defined below), in particular if the User
uses false data for the purpose of registration;
violates these Terms of Use or neglects its duty of care with regard to User Data;
violates any applicable laws in the access to or use of the Siemens Website; or
did not use the Siemens Website for a long period of time.
3.2. For registration the User shall give accurate information and, where such information changes over time, update such information (to the extent possible: online) without undue delay. The User shall ensure that its e-mail address, as supplied to Siemens, is current at all times and an address at which only the User can be contacted. For the avoidance of doubt, the e-mail address must be linked to a specific person (e.g. - john.smith@company.com). Generic or role-based e-mail addresses linked to groups or functions (e.g. - info@company.com) may not be used.
3.3. Upon registration the User will be provided with an access code, comprising a User ID and a password ("
User Data
"). On first access the User shall promptly change the password received from Siemens into a password known only to the User. The User Data allows the User to view or change its data or, as applicable, to withdraw its consent to data processing.
3.4. The User shall ensure that User Data is not accessible by third parties and is liable for all transactions and other activities carried out under its User Data. At the end of each online session, the User shall log-off from the password protected websites. If and to the extent the User becomes aware that third parties are misusing its User Data the User shall notify Siemens thereof without undue delay in writing, or, as the case may be, by e-mail.
3.5. After receipt of the notice under paragraph 3.4, Siemens will deny access to the password-protected area under such User Data. Access by the User will only be possible again upon the User's application to Siemens or upon new registration.

This shall not apply to source code related to open source software, which license conditions take priority over these Terms of Use in the case of transfer of open source software and which conditions require the making available of the source code. In such case Siemens shall make the source code available in return for the payment of costs.

Unless such is allowed by mandatory law, the User shall not modify the software or documentation nor shall it disassemble, reverse engineer or decompile the software or separate any part thereof. This includes, but is not limited to, any automated scraping, reproduction, or extraction of content, information, or data from the Siemens Website for the purpose of analysis, and for developing, training, or improving any artificial intelligence or machine learning systems;

6.3 Security Requirements
The User shall:

Not perform any penetration test of or on Siemens Websites or the underlying technology without obtaining Siemens' express prior written consent;

6.4 Monitoring, Enforcement, and Reporting
Siemens may monitor the User's compliance with and analyze any violation of these Terms of Use.
To ensure compliance with these Terms of Use, Siemens may take action against any content or resource that violates these Terms of Use or any other agreement Siemens has with the User for use of the Siemens Websites or where Siemens is permitted or required by law or a competent authority. This may include removing, restricting, limiting, or disabling access to content or requesting the User to modify the content. Siemens may also suspend or terminate the User's account if the User repeatedly or seriously infringes third-party rights, violates any law or regulation, these Terms of Use, or where Siemens is permitted or required to do so by law or a competent authority.
Information on how to report any violation of these Terms of Use, including any content the User believes to be illegal, can be found on the Digital Services Act information page on the Siemens Website, available under
https://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/about/compliance/eu-digital-services-act.html

https://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/about/compliance/reporting-channels.html

When Siemens receives notice of any violation of these Terms of Use, Siemens will manually review the reported activity. Siemens may suspend the handling of notices and complaints from a User for a reasonable period of time and after having issued a warning if the User frequently submits notices or complaints that are manifestly unfounded. When making such decisions, Siemens will assess, on a case-by-case basis and in a timely, diligent, and objective manner, the potential misuse and will consider all relevant facts and circumstances apparent from the information available to Siemens
Siemens may report any activity that Siemens suspects violates any law or regulation or forward any report as required by law to a competent authority or other appropriate third parties. Siemens may also share the User's content if a party claims that the User's use of the Siemens Website or the User's content violates third party's rights or any law or regulation.

This indemnification obligation does not apply to users who are consumers, i.e., natural persons acting for purposes outside their trade, business, or profession.

The Siemens Website may contain hyperlinks to the web pages of third parties. Siemens shall have no liability for the contents of such web pages and does not make representations about or endorse such web pages or their contents as its own, as Siemens does not control the information on such web pages and is not responsible for the content and information given thereon. B. Online Platforms and Marketplace Terms
These Online Platforms and Marketplace Terms amend the General Terms of Use (see A. General) with respect to the User's access to, or purchase of certain products or services on, Siemens online platforms and marketplaces offered via the Siemens Website:

Any online platform or marketplace on the Siemens Website is intended for business-to-business (B2B) use only and not for consumers. By registering and accessing the platform or marketplace, the User confirms acting for business, commercial, or professional purposes and not in the capacity of a consumer. Siemens may require the User to provide suitable proof of its status as an entrepreneur or business user (e.g., a VAT ID number). The data required for verification must be provided by the User in a complete and truthful manner.
2. Types of Offerings and Role of Siemens

Offerings

3.3. The Siemens Terms or Third-Party Terms applicable to an ordered Offering are referenced via links during the order process. Siemens recommends that the User saves or prints the applicable terms; Siemens does not save these terms for the User.
4. Orders and Conclusion of Contract
Unless expressly stated otherwise, the following process shall apply:
The presentation of Offerings on a platform or marketplace does not constitute a binding offer. Only the User's order constitutes a binding offer to the relevant seller to purchase the Offering. Prior to placing a binding order, the User will be presented with a summary of the order and will have the opportunity to identify and correct any input errors using the technical means provided. The User may cancel the ordering process at any time before the order becomes binding. When the User places an order, an email may be sent confirming the receipt of the order. This order receipt confirmation does not constitute an acceptance of the User's offer. A contract is only concluded if the order is accepted by the seller, which is typically confirmed with another email detailing the particulars of the order or by the provisioning of the Offering.
5. Maintenance and Support
Maintenance and support of Siemens Offerings will be provided pursuant to the applicable Siemens Terms. Any maintenance and support of Third-Party Offerings will be provided by the applicable third-party seller and only to the extent described in the applicable Third-Party Terms. Siemens is not responsible for any maintenance and support for Third-Party Offerings.
6. Payments and Invoicing
Where Offerings are available for purchase, the User must pay the applicable fees. The platform may offer various payment methods. For payment by credit card, fees are typically due in advance at the time of purchase, unless stated otherwise. For purchase on an existing account with Siemens, the payment terms contained in the separate agreement between the User and Siemens shall apply. The User consents to receiving electronic invoices from the respective seller (whether Siemens or a third-party) for all transactions conducted on the platform.
7. User's Representations and Authorizations
By entering payment information, the User represents that it is an authorized user of the payment method and that the associated information is accurate. The User authorizes Siemens or its payment service provider to:

8. Failed Payments
Siemens is not liable for any payments that are not completed due to insufficient funds or credit limit, incorrect information provided by the User, or other circumstances beyond Siemens’ reasonable control. To the extent any amounts owed cannot be collected from the payment method provided, Siemens has the right to charge the amount of any such transaction to the User's account (if any), to otherwise collect the amounts due from the User, or to terminate the related order.
9. Request for Quote Option
Certain Offerings may permit the option to request a quote from the applicable seller. Where the User selects this option, all resulting transactions will be concluded outside the platform in accordance with the applicable seller’s terms provided to the User along with the quote.

C. AI Terms of Use
These AI Terms of Use amend the Siemens Terms of Use (see A. General) with respect to any AI powered conversational experiences in services provided by Siemens on the Siemens website, as well as any other AI powered generative experiences on or resulting from services provided by Siemens on the Siemens website (collectively “
AI Services
”).

1. Nature and Limitations of Content
AI Services generate content for general informational use only. While this may encompass information related to Siemens, its products, and solutions, all such content is subject to inherent AI limitations and based on available training data. It is inherently subject to inaccuracies, incompleteness, or becoming outdated. This content does not constitute legal, medical, or professional advice, nor does it include binding offers or accurate pricing information. Specifically, AI Services are not intended to provide financial information, including forward-looking statements or capital market-related information, and the User of AI Services agrees not to rely on its responses for such purposes. The User should independently verify the accuracy and appropriateness of any content before relying on or utilizing such content for any purpose. Siemens disclaims all liability for any inaccuracies, omissions, or reliance on such content.
2. AI Services Use Restrictions
The User shall not:
use AI Services beyond the scope of access granted;
permit any other users to access or use AI Services to develop, train, or improve any other AI, including a competing or similar product or service;
use web scraping, web harvesting, web data extraction, or any other method to extract data from AI Services;
use AI Services to create content or use content in a manner that the User knows or should know infringes, misappropriates, or otherwise violates any intellectual property rights or other rights of any person, or that violates any applicable law, regulation, or rule.
3. High-Risk Use
AI Services are not intended for use in High-Risk contexts. Siemens will not be liable for any claims, damages, losses, costs, or liabilities arising from the use of our AI Services in High-Risk contexts, and the User will indemnify and hold Siemens harmless against any such claims.
"High-Risk contexts" means situations where AI Services are used to inform or make decisions that require enhanced safety measures or risk management features, such as fail-safe or fault-tolerant systems. This includes contexts where failure or malfunction may reasonably be expected to result in death, personal injury, property or environmental damage, or significant impacts on fundamental rights. High-Risk contexts include, but are not limited to, critical infrastructure, healthcare, transportation safety, biometric identification, education and employment decisions, law enforcement, migration, justice, and democratic processes, as well as any other high-risk AI practices defined or prohibited by applicable laws and regulations.
4. Liability
Sections 8 (Liability of defects for title or quality) and 9 (Other Liability, Viruses) of Siemens' general website Terms of Use (see A. General) apply mutatis mutandis to AI Services and its generated content. For these applications, references to "information," "software," "documentation," "goods," "services," "facilities," or "equipment" also include AI Services and its outputs.
5. Indemnity
By using AI Services, User agrees to indemnify and hold harmless Siemens, its affiliates, partners, and employees from any claims, losses, or damages arising out of or related to the use of AI Services or reliance on its outputs.
6. Use Rights of Siemens
Siemens may collect, store, and analyze conversational experiences with AI Services (input and generated content) to train and improve its products or services and enhance the overall user experience. This use includes, but is not limited to, identifying patterns, correcting inaccuracies, and enhancing response quality.
7. Use Rights for the User
Content generated by code generation features of AI Services may be subject to third party licenses, including, without limitation, open source licenses (“
Third Party Licenses
”) or Siemens proprietary licenses. Subject to the User’s compliance with these AI Terms of Use and to the extent such granting of use rights (i) is permitted by applicable law and (ii) does not conflict with rights of others (including Third Party Licenses) or Siemens proprietary licenses, as between the parties, Siemens grants the User a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free right to use the content generated by code generation features of our AI Services. Except for the use rights expressly granted herein, User shall not acquire any title, interest or right in any pre-existing, underlying or independently developed data, information, or intellectual property of Siemens. In case AI Services are embedded in the Siemens Xcelerator Developer Portal, the code generation features of AI Services are intended solely for content associated with and based on the Siemens Xcelerator Developer Portal. The User is expressly prohibited from using these features for content unrelated to the Siemens Xcelerator Developer Portal.
8. Changes to these AI Terms of Use
Siemens may modify these terms at any time.

FAQs
Does Siemens have corporate-wide rules of procedure?
Yes. Siemens operates a corporate-wide, transparent, publicly available, and standardized complaint and reporting procedure that is fully accessible. All complaints and reports from employees or third parties are treated similarly insofar as it is legally permitted.
Who can submit complaints and reports?
Everybody. The complaint and reporting procedure is open to all Siemens employees, external persons, and other organizations.
What can I report?
Any suspected or actual violations of laws or internal regulations, including those relating to human rights and environmental risks or obligations. The suspicion can be directed at individual Siemens employees, a Siemens business, or a Siemens supplier.
Do I have various options for submitting complaints or reports?
Yes. Siemens has various reporting channels for complaints or reports.
Complaints and reports can be submitted via the “
Tell Us
” hotline 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. They can be in writing or by phone – and you don’t even have to give your name if you don’t want to.
“Tell Us” is available in many different languages and is managed by an independent operator. The data is stored on protected servers in Germany. The content of the complaints or reports is processed exclusively by Siemens.
An external
Ombudsperson
is also available. The Ombudsperson is an independent lawyer outside Siemens whom you can contact confidentially and anonymously.
If you prefer to contact someone directly at Siemens, feel free to speak to any one of our Compliance Officers. You can also contact other Legal and Compliance personnel, company managers, the Human Resources personnel, employee representatives, or the Siemens Chief Compliance Officer.
Who will take care of my complaint or report?
The Siemens internal investigation department. This is the company’s central “Reporting Office”, which handles all complaints and reports, regardless of how they were submitted. The Reporting Office reports directly to the Chief Compliance Officer, who has access to the Managing Board and the Supervisory Board of Siemens AG. Employees of the Reporting Office are subject to a special duty of confidentiality, are impartial, and have the necessary expertise to professionally handle complaints and reports.
The company may contact you if additional information is needed, and in some instances the German Supply Chain Due Diligence Act (LkSG) may require us to discuss with you your complaint. Of course, this only works if we can contact you.
Will the company keep my identity confidential?
Yes. All complaints and reports may be submitted anonymously, and Siemens takes great care to protect you as a reporter and ensures your complaint or report is kept confidential. Confidential data may only be disclosed on an as-needed basis as permitted by law. These principles apply regardless of the reporting channel.
Will I be informed that my complaint or report is being processed?
Yes. Within seven days of receipt of your complaint or report, you will receive an acknowledgement of receipt from Siemens.
Will all complaints and reports be processed?
Yes. We take all complaints and reports seriously. The Reporting Office examines each complaint and report to clarify whether there is sufficient information to process the matter. We may request additional information from you.
What happens to my complaint or report once it has been examined?
It depends: After the Reporting Office examines your complaint or report, it may forward it to another responsible department within the company for further handling and fact-finding or to a competent authority, or handle it itself. If the Reporting Office deems an internal investigation necessary, an Investigation Mandate will be issued. During the investigation, the Reporting Office reviews relevant documents, speaks with witnesses and affected parties, and, if necessary, analyzes electronic data.
At the end of the fact-finding, the results are summarized in a report that is distributed to relevant internal stakeholders. Results may include recommendations for disciplinary action or other remedial measures, such as risk management and internal process measures.
Insofar as it is possible and legally permissible, we will inform you
within three months
of the measures taken – even if the fact-finding has not been completed by then.
Are there rules in place for fact-finding?
Yes. All employees who are involved in internal fact-finding must adhere to certain
rules of conduct
, including:
The whistleblower must be protected! Their name and details of their report must be kept confidential on a need-to-know basis.
All fact-finding must be performed respectfully, objectively, and without any presumption.
Employees implicated by a complaint or report have the right to be heard.
Data and information must be treated confidentially on a need-to-know basis and consistent with legal requirements.
Any potential or actual conflict of interest on the part of any person engaged in fact-finding must be disclosed and the fact-finder must remove themselves from the matter.
Am I protected as a whistleblower?
Yes. Siemens will not tolerate retaliation of any kind.
Persons who in good faith submit complaints or reports will be fully protected. If you believe you or anyone else has been retaliated against or in any way has been treated differently for submitting a complaint or report, you should inform our company immediately through any of its reporting channels (preferably via “
Tell Us
“).
We follow up on all plausible allegations of retaliation or mistreatment. Severe measures will be imposed in response to substantiated act of retaliation.

Ez a weboldal sütiket használ. A Cookies kis fájlok, amelyek bizonyos információkat tartalmaznak, és tárolódnak az Ön eszközén. A weboldalon található cookie-k vagy a Siemenstől származnak - ebben az esetben ezek az úgynevezett „első fél cookie-k” - vagy bizonyos harmadik felektől, amelyek szolgáltatásait a Siemens használ; ebben az esetben „harmadik féltől származó cookie-król” beszélünk.
A Cookies szükségesek a weboldal bizonyos funkcióinak biztosításához, például a felhasználó által választott nyelvválasztás fenntartásához. A Cookies funkciójuktól és rendeltetésüktől függően négy kategóriába sorolhatók: feltétlenül szükséges cookie-k, teljesítménysütik, funkcionalitási cookie-k és marketing cookie-k.
Szigorúan szükséges Cookies
Ezek a cookie-k nélkülözhetetlenek ahhoz, hogy Ön a weboldalon mozogjon és használja annak funkcióit, mint például az adatvédelmi beállítások beállítása, a bejelentkezés vagy az űrlapok kitöltése. Ezen cookie-k nélkül a weboldalunk használatával igényelt szolgáltatások nem nyújthatók megfelelően.
A szigorúan szükséges cookie-k nem igényelnek hozzájárulást a felhasználótól az alkalmazandó jogszabályok szerint. A böngészőjét úgy konfigurálhatja, hogy blokkolja a szigorúan szükséges cookie-kat, de előfordulhat, hogy nem tudja használni a weboldal funkcióit a rendeltetésszerűen.
Amennyiben a feltétlenül szükséges cookie-kkal kapcsolatban feldolgozott információk egy adott esetben személyes adatnak minősülnek, az adatkezelés jogalapja a Siemens jogos érdeke a weboldal üzemeltetéséhez.

Segítenek abban, hogy jobban megértsük a felhasználók viselkedését weboldalunkon. Ez azért szükséges, hogy javítsa a weboldal felhasználóbarát jellegét, és ezáltal javítsa a felhasználói élményt. A teljesítménysütik által gyűjtött további információk lehetnek például: az internetböngésző és a használt operációs rendszer, a korábban meglátogatott weboldal domain neve, a látogatások száma, a látogatások átlagos időtartama és a felhívott oldalak.

title: Data Privacy | Siemens | Siemens
text:
Data Privacy | Siemens | Siemens

Home
Data privacy

Privacy@Siemens
Data privacy is an integral part of Siemens' business activities and processes. This website provides insight on the various elements that form the Siemens approach to data privacy that is committed to protecting the privacy of our employees, customers, suppliers and consumers.

Your data, your rights
We believe that one of the most important elements of a company’s data privacy program is to provide transparency on its processing operations. That is why we developed our
Data Privacy Notice
to explain how we handle personal data and how you can exercise your rights.
You control your data – Siemens as data processor
Using our products and services often means entrusting Siemens with processing one of the most valuable assets of a company – its data. That is why data privacy forms an integral part of our offerings. You can learn more by visiting the
Siemens Data Privacy Trust Center
.
Security
There is no Privacy without Security. With our unique holistic cybersecurity approach, we make it possible for you to introduce and maintain a digitized organization that is secure and reliable at all times. By combining this with our global leading technology and industrial expertise, we are continually working on reinforcing the comprehensive protections among all our products, solutions and services. That’s how we keep you – and society as a whole – secure. Please visit our
Cybersecurity website
to learn more.
Our global data privacy commitment – The Binding Corporate Rules
Protecting personal data is a top priority for all companies within the Siemens group. For this reason, Siemens was one of the first companies within Germany to obtain and implement Binding Corporate Rules (BCR) approved by the data protection authorities of the European Union. Siemens has also obtained and implemented the BCR for the United Kingdom (UK BCR Addendum) which were approved by the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO). Siemens’ BCR certification demonstrates our strong commitment to the protection of personal data whenever it is transferred or accessed globally by Siemens’ companies. You find a summary of the Siemens EU BCR and the UK BCR Addendum below:
-
Siemens EU BCR
-
UK BCR Addendum
You are in the driver seat – Data privacy in Siemens products and services
We build in privacy from the start. When designing, planning and developing our products and services, we embed data privacy milestones directly into the product development process and strive to provide features and functionalities that give customers full control over their data privacy settings.
Our mission: Siemens Data Privacy Management System
Siemens values the importance of privacy and protecting personal information. To put data privacy into action throughout the Siemens group, we developed and implemented the Siemens Data Privacy Management System. Siemens closely monitors regulatory developments as well as reports, guidance, recommendations and statements of its competent data protection authorities and the European Data Protection Board. If required, we update our Data Privacy Management accordingly.
In this section, you will find a summary of our Data Privacy Management System and where you can get more information.

Home
Digitális szál
Digitális szál: a digitális átalakulás újradefiniálása
Az intelligens gyártás korában a digitális szál az innováció, az optimalizálás és a működési kiválóság játékmegváltoztató megközelítése. A Siemens Digital Industries Software olyan digitális szálakat kínál, amelyek segítenek a modern vállalkozásoknak abban, hogy a komplexitást versenyelőnyré alakítsák.
Digitális szálak megtekintése

Mi az a digitális szál?
A digitális szál egyesíti a termék életciklusának minden szakaszát — a koncepciótól a gyártásig. Megbízható adatáramlást hoz létre, lebontja a silókat, elősegíti az együttműködést és gyorsabb döntéseket hoz. Ez a teljes körű láthatóság átalakítja a folyamatokat egy agilis vállalkozássá, felgyorsítva az innovációt, javítja a minőséget és javítja az ügyfélélményt.

Az innováció ösztönzése
Milyen szerepet játszik a digitális szál?
A digitális szál olyan átalakító erő, amely meghaladja a puszta technológiai megoldásokat, stratégiai eszközként szolgál a szervezetek számára a kihívások leküzdésére és a példátlan üzleti érték feltárására. Digitális szál:
Javítja a vállalati együttműködést és lehetővé teszi az időben történő, megalapozott döntéshozatalt A kommunikációs akadályok felszámolásával és a termék életciklusának átfogó, teljes körű áttekintésével lehetővé teszi a csapatok számára, hogy összhangban dolgozzanak a közös célok elérése érdekében, növelve a hatékonyságot és a termelékenységet.
Felgyorsítja az új termékek bevezetését, és segít kezelni a modern termékfejlesztés egyre növekvő összetettségét. A valós idejű betekintések és a prediktív képességek kihasználásával a szervezetek gyorsan reagálhatnak a változó piaci igényekre, optimalizálhatják a karbantartási stratégiákat és kivételes ügyfélélményt nyújthatnak.
Korai áttekintést nyújt a tervezési változásokhoz, kiküszöbölve a késői szakaszban történő módosítások költséges és pazarló következményeit. Ez az előretekintő megközelítés lehetővé teszi a proaktív problémamegoldást és a termékadatok hatékony újrafelhasználását, tovább tömörítve az idővonalakat és javítva az általános működési kiválóságot.

Melyek a digitális szál megközelítés legfontosabb előnyei?
Fokozott együttműködés
A silók lebontása és a részlegek közötti zökkenőmentes kommunikáció elősegítése.
Javított hatékonyság
Az adatvezérelt betekintésekkel egyszerűsítheti a műveleteket és csökkentse a piacra jutás idejét.
Kiváló termékminőség
Használja ki valós idejű visszajelzési hurkokat a termékek finomításához és a problémák korai kezeléséhez
Sustainability
Csökkentse a hulladékot és optimalizálja az erőforrások felhasználását a prediktív elemzés és automatizálás
Kivételes ügyfélélmény
Kínáljon megbízható, kiváló minőségű termékeket, amelyek robusztus szerviztámogatással támogatják.

Digitális szálak minden folyamathoz
A digitális szálak egyszerűsítik az ellátási láncokat, javítják a termékfejlesztést és erősítik a biztonságot. Méretezhető, adaptálható képességeket kínálnak, amelyek növelik a hatékonyságot és az innovációt az iparágak között.

all
Integrált életciklus-menedzsment
Egységesítse az adatokat a termék életciklusában a tervezés, a gyártás és a működési betekintések zökkenőmentes integrálásával. Ez a szál felhatalmazza a csapatokat az igazság egyetlen forrásának fenntartására, javítva az együttműködést és a döntéshozatalt.
all
Modellalapú rendszertervezés (MBSE)
Emelje meg a komplex rendszertervezést a mechanikai, elektromos és szoftveres rendszerek integrálásával egy egységes digitális modellbe. Ez a szál holisztikus képet nyújt a rendszertervezésről, biztosítva a megbízhatóságot és a teljesítményt.
all
Szolgáltatás életciklus-elemzése
Kivételes ügyfélélményt nyújt a prediktív karbantartás, a használati elemzés és a visszajelzési ciklusok kihasználásával. Ez a szál biztosítja, hogy a termékek megbízhatóak maradjanak és megfeleljenek az ügyfelek elvárásainak egész életciklusuk során.
all
Ellátási lánc együttműködése
Erősítse meg a szorosabb partnerségeket és javítsa a láthatóságot az ellátási láncban. Ez a szál a digitális ikreket és a valós idejű adatokat használja ki az együttműködés javítása, a késedelmek csökkentése és a készletkezelés optimalizálása érdekében.

Digitális szálak iparágak szerint
A digitális szálak megalapozzák az átalakulást, de valódi hatásuk az iparágspecifikus adaptációból származik. Az ipari digitális szálak finomítják az alapvető képességeket, összehangolva a digitális stratégiákat az ágazatspecifikus kihívásokhoz, munkafolyamatokhoz, valamint a maximális hatékonyság és innováció lehetőségeihez.

Digitális szál gyakran ismételt kérdések
Mi a digitális szál, és miért fontos?
A digitális szál egy folyamatos adatáramlás, amely összeköti a termék életciklusának minden szakaszát, a tervezéstől a gyártásig, a szolgáltatásig és azon túl. Fontos, mert kiküszöböli a silókat, javítja az együttműködést, javítja a hatékonyságot és felgyorsítja az innovációt azáltal, hogy egyetlen igazságforrást biztosít egy szervezetben.
Miben különbözik a digitális szál a digitális ikertől?
A digital twin egy fizikai eszköz, rendszer vagy folyamat virtuális ábrázolása, amelyet szimulációra és elemzésre használnak. A digitális szál viszont az adatok zökkenőmentes integrálása a termék életciklusa során, lehetővé téve a folyamatosságot és a nyomon követhetőséget a különböző szakaszokban.
Mely iparágak profitálnak a legjobban a digitális szálakból?
Az olyan iparágak, mint a gyártás, a repülőgépipar, az autóipar, az egészségügy és az energia jelentős előnyöket élveznek a digitális szálak Ezek az iparágak összetett termékfejlesztésre, ellátási lánc menedzsmentre és valós idejű adatelemzésre támaszkodnak a hatékonyság és az innováció növelése érdekében.
Milyen kihívásokkal szembesülnek a vállalatok a digitális szál megvalósításakor?
Néhány gyakori kihívás a következők:
Régebbi rendszerek integrálása a modern digitális infrastruktúrákkal
Hatalmas mennyiségű adat kezelése osztályok között
Az adatbiztonság és a megfelelőség biztosítása
Szervezeti részvétel megszerzése a digitális átalakulási kezdeményezésekhez
Hogyan kezdhetik el a vállalatok egy digitális szál megvalósítását?
A vállalatok a következőkkel kezdhetik:

Mi a fenntartható digitális vállalkozás?
Fenntartható
Digitális Vállalkozás
A Siemens egyedülálló megközelítése, amely egyesíti a valós és a digitális világot holisztikus portfóliójával, hosszú tapasztalatával és domain-know-howjával, lehetővé teszi az ipari vállalatok számára, hogy zökkenőmentesen integrálják és digitalizálják a teljes termék- és termelési életciklust, beleértve az ellátási láncot is. Ez hozzájárul ahhoz, hogy fenntartható digitális vállalkozássá váljon, amely folyamatosan optimalizálja az adatok alapján, és az osztályában legjobb termékeket és termelést hozhat létre a fenntarthatóbb jövő érdekében.
Milyen előnyei vannak a digitális vállalkozássá válásnak?
A valós és a digitális világ kombinálásának képessége lehetővé teszi a vállalatok számára, hogy termékeket, gépeket, vonalakat, sőt egész gyárakat és üzemeket tervezzenek, szimuláljanak, teszteljenek, optimalizáljanak és validáljanak a digitális világban, ezáltal gyorsabbá, hatékonyabbá és fenntarthatóbbá téve őket a való világban. Az eredmény egy folyamatos optimalizálási hurok, a termék tervezésétől a megvalósításig és optimalizálásáig, folyamatos adatáramlással. A fenntartható digitális vállalkozás képes kihasználni az adatok korlátlan erejét azáltal, hogy értékes betekintést nyer a gyors és magabiztos döntések meghozatalához. Ez csak azért lehetséges, mert a Siemensnél mindent megteszünk annak érdekében, hogy ügyfeleink számára a jobb, gyorsabb, jövedelmezőbb és fenntarthatóbbá váláshoz szükséges megoldásokat biztosítsuk: automatizálási hardver, ipari szoftver és egy holisztikus megközelítés, amely lehetővé teszi számukra, hogy a teljes termék- és gyártási életciklust, beleértve az ellátási láncokat is, hatékonyabbá és fenntarthatóbbá tegyék. Más szavakkal, a Siemens Xcelerator segítségével fenntartható digitális vállalkozássá válás egyértelmű előnyöket biztosít az emberek és a társadalom számára, mivel olyan technológiát biztosít, amely átalakítja a mindennapot, mindenki számára.

The world is changing faster and faster – and it's changing now. It's happening every day. Our customers, employees, and society are facing an ever-increasing number of challenges. EHS is about more than just meeting compliance requirements, laws, regulations, or industry standards. It's about understanding EHS as an important driver of the overall business strategy. And we do so based on the company's values: responsible, excellent, and innovative.

Sustainbility Report 2024: Responsibility for a better future
For over 176 years, we have been developing innovative technologies to tackle the challenge of our time and improve the lives of billions of people. With our holistic approach to sustainability, the
DEGREE framework
, we set clear goals in the areas of climate protection, resource management, diversity, health, safety and corporate governance. The Sustainability Report 2024 shows how we are implementing these goals, making progress and making a positive contribution to society and the environment together with our employess and partners.

Environmental protection
As a global player, we bear a special responsibility for worldwide challenges such as demographic change, climate change, and limited resources. Environmental protection has been a central focus for us since 1971.
We harmonize economic, ecological, and social requirements and meet our social responsibility head on. We use technological progress and innovative solutions to minimize the negative impact of our business activities on the environment. At the same time, we ensure our long-term competitiveness by making the most of valuable and often expensive raw materials.
At Siemens, we offer a comprehensive range of expertise, all in one place. We provide competitive, environmentally friendly product design, improved resource efficiency, assessment and advice on environmental risks, and support for legal certainty.

50 years of environmental protection
Fifty years ago, Siemens' management set the course for a corporate policy that recognizes its responsibility toward people and the environment by establishing a department for environmental protection.
Dive into the history of environmental protection at Siemens!

Conserving natural resources through a circular economy
The goal of a circular economy is to conserve natural resources by closing material and energy cycles as efficiently as possible. This process begins with product design. At every stage of processing, materials are used in a way that minimizes residual waste and maintains closed-loop systems. After a long lifespan, the end product can be almost entirely recycled, keeping a significant portion of raw materials within the production cycle. By supporting this approach, we contribute to protecting our environment.
Towards Zero Waste – Waste Separation at the Munich Perlach Site
We take waste and resource management very seriously. In a world with a rapidly growing population and increasingly scarce resources, this issue is becoming ever more important. That’s why we have made waste management a key component of the global EHS environmental program.
Our goal is to ensure that no waste ends up in landfills but remains within the economic cycle. With a recycling rate of 99 %, the Munich Perlach site is well on its way to achieving this objective.

Take-back offer for packaging, old electrical appliances and batteries
Some packaging, electrical appliances and batteries contain harmful substances that pollute the environment hen released. They also contain valuable resources that can be reused through recycling. Points of sale for electrical appliances are therefore obliged to take back old appliances, and our customers can also return packaging, electrical appliances, and batters to enable resource-conserving disposal.
Learn more

Health management
It is a simple fact that a healthy working environment is a prerequisite for satisfied, motivated and creative employees.
We align health activities in the company with the requirements of today's working world and continuously improve occupational health management.
Our workplace health promotion strengthens the physical and mental health of people in the company, increasing motivation in the long term, reducing sickness costs, improving the employer image and increasing competitiveness. We rely on a planned approach and support the implementation of local requirements for the promotion of health issues with suitable instruments.

We are committed to integrating the promotion and empowerment of people as an indispensable part of our corporate strategy. This approach has also been recognised and appreciated externally.
We have been confirmed as leaders in occupational health management following a comprehensive and successful Corporate Health Audit, which led to the presentation of the Corporate Health Award 2022.
Our workplace health promotion is tailored to the needs of Siemens employees and offers a wide range of programs and preventive measures. We make a significant contribution in the area of resilience and mental health in particular. We know that investing in our colleagues is the most valuable investment we can make in our company.
Learn more

The topic of employment in Germany is changing fundamentally, and occupational medicine must adapt to meet these new demands. The interfaces are called Work 4.0 and Medicine 4.0.
A healthy working environment is essential for satisfied, motivated and creative employees, and thus for a company's competitiveness.
Medical Services provides statutory occupational health services and manages all issues relating to health in the workplace. In addition, we develop and implement tailored concepts for the promotion, prevention, maintenance and restoration of employee health in close coordination with other EHS specialist areas.
We are committed to promoting motivation and performance, and we are confident that we can achieve this by encouraging our employees to adopt a healthy lifestyle.
The experts at Health Promotion are ready to advise and support employees and managers with programs in the areas of promoting physical activity, a healthy working environment, nutrition and mental health. We believe that holistic prevention approaches are the key to success.
By developing health skills and strengthening personal responsibility, we are certain that we can enable employees to successfully meet current and future challenges in the world of work.

The social counselling service provides confidential support to employees in coping with psychological stress, work-life balance and life-changing events. It raises awareness and advises managers on the topic of healthy leadership, conflicts in the workplace and provides coaching in challenging situations.
It is crucial to prioritize health in the workplace. It's time to talk about mental health. We need to be open about mental illness, not hide it away.
One in four adults experiences a mental illness. It is unacceptable that 70 percent of those affected do not seek help due to fear of prejudice and stigmatisation. The fear of being seen as unreliable, no longer able to cope or unable to perform prevents many of those affected from talking openly about their illness.
We are committed to removing the stigma around mental health in the workplace. An open approach helps people manage existing mental illness and identify and prevent stress at an early stage.
